--- /dev/null
+++ b/migrations/0009_dashboard_sessions.up.sql
@@ -0,0 +1,31 @@
+BEGIN;
+
+CREATE TABLE dashboard_users (
+    id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
+    provider text NOT NULL CHECK (provider IN ('github', 'gitlab')),
+    provider_user_id text NOT NULL,
+    created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
+    UNIQUE (provider, provider_user_id)
+);
+
+CREATE TABLE dashboard_memberships (
+    user_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES dashboard_users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
+    installation_id bigint NOT NULL REFERENCES installations(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
+    active boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
+    created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
+    PRIMARY KEY (user_id, installation_id)
+);
+
+CREATE TABLE dashboard_sessions (
+    token_hash bytea PRIMARY KEY CHECK (octet_length(token_hash) = 32),
+    user_id uuid NOT NULL,
+    installation_id bigint NOT NULL,
+    csrf_hash bytea NOT NULL CHECK (octet_length(csrf_hash) = 32),
+    expires_at timestamptz NOT NULL,
+    created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
+    FOREIGN KEY (user_id, installation_id) REFERENCES dashboard_memberships(user_id, installation_id) ON DELETE CASCADE
+);
+
+CREATE INDEX dashboard_sessions_expiry ON dashboard_sessions (expires_at);
+
+COMMIT;

explanations.title: Add validated dashboard session creation
explanations.summary: Sessions are limited to GitHub and GitLab identities, require a non-empty user and organization plus a future expiry, and receive a newly generated CSRF token when created.

explanations.title: Validate requests and organization switches
explanations.summary: Requests can be rejected when the session is expired or the CSRF token does not match. Organization switches now require an active membership and an unexpired session.

explanations.title: Persist dashboard identities and memberships
explanations.summary: The migration adds dashboard identities unique per provider user and memberships linking users to installations. Memberships are active by default and are removed when the related user or installation is deleted.

explanations.title: Persist hashed session credentials
explanations.summary: Dashboard sessions store fixed-length token and CSRF hashes rather than OAuth bearer-token columns, and must reference an existing user membership. Deleting that membership removes its sessions; an expiry index supports expiry-based queries.
